_comment: A REAL Smithii Mantis `Launch` account, read from Solana mainnet-beta on 2026-10-08 (slot 454609758) with getAccountInfo(encoding=base64).
It belongs to a THIRD PARTY's sale, not ours; it is public chain data kept only so the decoder in smithii_lib.mjs is tested against real bytes instead of bytes this repo wrote itself.

Why this is trusted as a fixture, each point observed independently of the decoder: (1) the first 8 bytes equal sha256('account:Launch')[0..8], the Anchor tag for that account name; (2) the authority and mint fields equal the launchAuthority and mint accounts listed by a real `buy` transaction against this launch; (3) sold_amount equals the 0.5 SOL that buy paid; (4) this launch's vault token account held 350000000000000 raw units of a 6-decimal token, which is hardcap 140 SOL / price 400 lamports per token — the escrow formula tokens = hardcap_lamports * 10^decimals / price_lamports.
The 7 bytes after payment_method are zero; the SDK's documented layout ends at byte 185 and the account is 192 bytes, so the decoder ignores the tail and a test records that it was all zero.

vault._note: getTokenAccountsByOwner(launch, mint) on 2026-10-08 returned this single token account; it is the associated token account of the launch PDA (owner off-curve).
